method: Claude for Chrome extension on the user's real Chrome (CDP 9222 was not listening). Passive page load of https://psyclelondon.com/pages/oxford-circus-timetable read via Resource Timing, plus a handful of read-only GETs issued from the page context (no Authorization header, so unauthenticated). No writes.
site_calls_after_clicking_a_later_date_t: GET /api/customer/v2/events?filter[between]=2026-10-19,2026-10-20&filter[location.handle]=oxford-circus&sort=start_at   (the clicked day, one call per day)
GET /api/customer/v2/events?filter[between]=2026-10-07T00:00:00+01:00,2026-10-10T00:00:00+01:00&sort=start_at   (NO location filter; offset-bearing ISO bounds, a different caller, fired alongside)
date_carousel: 14 day tabs (today + 13). Each tab loads its own single-day range lazily; the first three days load eagerly.
location_param: filter[location.handle]=<handle>. Honoured server-side: handle oxford-circus on 2026-10-07 returned 48 events across 7 studios and relations.locations had 1 entry; no filter returned 124 events, 22 studios, 8 locations (oxford-circus, clapham, psycle-bank, shoreditch, victoria, psycle-london-bridge, notting-hill, psycle-at-home).
between_semantics: End bound is exclusive for date-only values: 2026-10-07,2026-10-08 returned events from 2026-10-07 only (first 06:20, last 20:15). ISO-with-offset bounds also accepted.

range_probes_location_oxford_circus.note: 43-day span: NOT rejected, identical to the 42-day result

range_findings: No server-side cap on span was hit up to 56 days; no 4xx.

The schedule's publish horizon is ~23 days out (last event 2026-10-29 on 2026-10-06), so any wider range returns the same set. The 42-day cap in C2-4 is a client-chosen safety bound, not an API limit.

Location scoping holds on ranged calls: re-checked with the site's param order, both the 7-day and 42-day calls returned relations.locations = [oxford-circus] only (283 and 986 events; about 48 per day across 7 studios is consistent).
Response is one unpaginated body: no links, no meta, no page params. Payload is large (about 3.8 MB for 986 events).

envelope_unauthenticated.relations_shape: instructors/event_types/studios/locations/credit_types are arrays; plans is an object keyed by index
envelope_unauthenticated.note: booking_cutoff / extended_cutoff / booked_events / friends_booked (seen in events-v2-sample.json) are ABSENT without a bearer token; they appear only on authenticated calls.
envelope_unauthenticated.response_headers_of_interest: cache-control: no-cache, private. No rate-limit headers seen.

event_field_notes.occupancy_and_capacity: present on every event, so ranged /events carries live fill counts
